⚖️ LEGAL UPDATE | WOMEN IN THE LEGAL PROFESSION
Representation matters. And equal opportunities in the legal profession matter even more.
Justice B.V. Nagarathna has emphasized that women lawyers must have at least one-third representation on government panels, highlighting the importance of inclusivity, equal opportunity and greater representation of women in the legal system.
A more inclusive legal profession is a step towards a stronger, fairer and more representative justice system.
Empowering women in law means strengthening justice itself.
